title: Asymptotic Optimality of $cμ$-Rule for LLM Inference Scheduling under Memory Constraint
title_zh: 内存约束下LLM推理调度cμ规则的渐近最优性

paragraphs.en: 研究提出内存约束下LLM推理调度的cμ优先级规则，证明其渐近最优并在真实引擎中显著降低延迟。 Large language model (LLM) inference, the process by which a pre-trained model receives an input prompt and generates output tokens sequentially, has become increasingly important with the widespread deployment of LLM-based applications. As inference workloads continue to scale, GPU memory has emerged as a critical bottleneck: the long input prompts and generation sequences common in agentic and reasoning workloads lead to substantial key-value (KV) cache usage. In this paper, we study the resulting online scheduling problem from a queueing perspective. Requests arrive stochastically with heterogeneous prompt and output lengths, undergo prefill and autoregressive decode, and compete for a finite KV-cache capacity. Unlike classical queueing models, the duration of a processing step depends on both prefill computation and KV-cache I/O, so service capacity is jointly determined by computation, memory access, and memory occupancy. We develop a fluid model that reduces the system to a multiclass single-server queue with effective service rates capturing computation, memory access, and memory capacity. This fluid analysis yields a $cμ$ priority rule, where the effective service rate $μ$ is jointly determined by computational speed, memory bandwidth, and memory capacity. We prove that this rule minimizes cumulative holding cost in the fluid model and, for a finite workload, also minimizes completion time and maximizes full-run output-token throughput. We then construct a feasible scheduling policy for the original finite system and prove that its scaled dynamics converge to the optimal fluid policy. Finally, experiments on a real LLM serving engine using an NVIDIA H800 show that practical implementations of the proposed priority rule substantially reduce average latency while maintaining high throughput relative to existing scheduling policies.
paragraphs.zh: 研究提出内存约束下LLM推理调度的cμ优先级规则，证明其渐近最优并在真实引擎中显著降低延迟。 大语言模型（LLM）推理是指预训练模型接收输入提示词并按顺序生成输出词元的过程，随着基于LLM的应用的广泛部署，这一过程正变得日益重要。 随着推理工作负载的不断扩展，GPU显存已成为关键瓶颈：智能体与推理类工作负载中常见的长输入提示词和生成序列会带来大量的键值（KV）缓存占用。 在本文中，我们从排队论的视角研究由此产生的在线调度问题。 请求以随机方式到达，具有异构的提示词长度与输出长度，经历预填充（prefill）和自回归解码阶段，并竞争有限的KV缓存容量。 与经典排队模型不同，一个处理步骤的时长同时取决于预填充计算和KV缓存的输入输出，因此服务能力由计算、内存访问和内存占用共同决定。 我们构建了一个流体模型，将系统简化为多类单服务器队列，其有效服务率同时刻画了计算、内存访问和内存容量。 该流体分析得出了 $c\mu$ 优先级规则，其中有效服务率 $\mu$ 由计算速度、内存带宽和内存容量共同决定。 我们证明该规则在流体模型中最小化累积持有成本，并且对于有限工作负载，还能最小化完成时间并最大化全程输出词元吞吐量。 随后，我们为原始的有限系统构造了一个可行的调度策略，并证明其缩放后的动态收敛于最优流体策略。 最后，在基于NVIDIA H800的真实LLM服务引擎上的实验表明，相较于现有的调度策略，所提出的优先级规则的实际实现能在保持高吞吐量的同时显著降低平均延迟。
